title: The Five Mysteries of the First Man; the Hidden Senses; the Three Forms in the Eye
description: The deepest interior of the soul's full reception. T94 — the five garments of the Divine Human and the hundred holy days: the soul fasts from what the self had set on its table and is fed by the Call-Answer as living food; the period of laying off opens out into the period of conjunction. T95 — the hidden powers in the senses, sorted daily: divine seals and disordered shapes alike marking the body, with the discrimination working in voice, in stillness, and in the Father's twelvefold completeness. T96 — the visible and hidden registers of understanding, and the riddle of the eye: the pupil sees by day but fails by night because seeing was never the eye's own; the pupil is the gate between upper and lower place through which the divine descends and the lower is gathered up.
